senses.gloss: (v. אֲדַק) to be fastened, stick to. Part. pass. עָדִיק.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 78a">Gitt. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>דע׳ ליה בחרציה וכ׳</he> Mus. (v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. <he>עויק</he>; Ar. <he>עויק</he>, <cite ref="P00555"><he>עייק</he></cite>, corr. acc.; ed. <he>דערק לה וכ׳</he>, v. infra) when it (the letter of divorce) sticks in his belt, and she takes it out.

senses.gloss: to bring close to. Ib. דע׳ לה חרציה וכ׳ (ed. דערק, corr. acc.) when he pressed his loins (the belt in which the letter of divorce was sticking) close to her, and she took the letter out.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:45">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 45</cite> (ed. Vien. <he>ויערק׳</he>, corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="A00438"><he>אֲדַק</he></cite>.
